verdict.rationale: Epic's physics documentation describes Chaos Physics as Unreal Engine's built-in simulation system. It lists Rigid Body Dynamics as a major feature and links dedicated Collision (responses and presets) and Traces with Raycasts sections, which covers all three elements of the story as first-party capabilities. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that rigid bodies, collisions and raycasts work out of the box; the collision and raycast pages are evidenced only as link titles, not detailed content.
